selection_unit: one pixel per fixed camera per stratum, min lexicographic SHA256 hexadecimal, no replacement of empty/hard/ambiguous strata

strata.name: PA_EXPECTED_INTERIOR
strata.definition: PA and all eight native neighbours PA; out-of-frame neighbours false

strata.name: KNOWN_SELF_BLOCKED
strata.definition: PA and PS certain nonnegative other-target owner; no ambiguity or background included

strata.name: KNOWN_FOREIGN_BLOCKED
strata.definition: raw certain PSselected and PV certain foreign owner

strata.name: AMBIGUOUS_SELECTED_TIED
strata.definition: PA and PS or PV different-owner ambiguity, with selectedpart depth in final minimum tie set at the ambiguous stage

strata.name: AMBIGUOUS_SELECTED_NOT_TIED
strata.definition: PA and PS or PV different-owner ambiguity, without selectedpart in that stage final minimum tie set

empty_strata: Retain explicit0, no alternate view/pixel or quality search.
overlaps: Selection rows retain all stratum memberships. Repeated camera/pixel rays may be computed once and joined back to each selected row.
inference_from_selection: Outcome-conditioned source mask diagnostic, not prevalence estimation, human annotation or a benchmark sample.
oracle: After explicit root authorization only: use bound exported world triangles and fixed camera metadata; intersect each selected camera-axis ray directly with triangle planes and test barycentric inclusion/top-left coverage independently of the production raster function. Recover nearest Z/part/face tie set and compare saved PA/PS/PV buffers. No triangle filtering by saved winner or predicted success.
numeric_policy: Report absolute and relative depth differences in full; compare owner/coverage/U exactly under frozen production edge/culling/tie conventions. Any discrepancy is reported, never silently corrected or used to relax a label threshold.
required_report: nearest and tied source face/part IDs, cameraZ differences
raw subset violation counts and A/V/S/E/U partition discrepancy counts
whether ambiguity or background could incorrectly enter SELF
literal target-layer/PS immutability and foreign geometry metadata provenance

restrictions.until_root_actual_authorization: No saved pixel buffers, source mesh NPZ or actual render read.
